subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should the experimental Claw cron lifecycle be sponsored as a separately landable stack slice once its real Gateway and persisted-state upgrade proof is complete?
rationale: The patch adds an experimental lifecycle capability across Gateway RPC, agent deletion, and shared state; deciding whether and how this stacked capability enters the product cannot be resolved from code review alone.

options.title: Sponsor guarded landing
options.body: Keep the experimental gate, require exact-head running-Gateway and upgrade proof, then land in the agreed dependency order.

options.title: Pause the Claws rollout slice
options.body: Leave the branch open but do not advance it until maintainers confirm the broader Claws product and stack direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor guarded landing
recommendation.body: Keep the experimental gate, require exact-head running-Gateway and upgrade proof, then land in the agreed dependency order.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the PR and set the canonical cron/deletion lifecycle requirements in review.
